name: Sunbeam hall: light the sensor
notes: Reference puzzle for light (mw-e15.9), built with data only: a sunlight beam source, two rotatable mirror prefabs, a beam sensor and a brazier, with a signal latch that raises the portcullis. The goal is the outcome (the sensor is lit, or the brazier beside it burns, for a second), so turning the mirrors, carrying flame to the brazier or casting Ember at it all count. There is no light spell yet (see the gap bead filed with this puzzle) and a light receiver only answers beams, so the brazier route is expressed in the goal as an alternative, not as light on the sensor. Greybox, not story canon.
